shots.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a polished landscape 16:9 interactive art exhibition proposal still, one full-bleed image, no panels, no captions, no watermark. The concept is a visitor filmed with a normal webcam in front of a chroma-key screen, then their photoreal human cutout composited as a giant into a digital miniature city. Render the FINAL COMPOSITED SCREEN, not a physical exhibition room, and no visible green screen. It must be instantly obvious that the person is real photographic footage whereas the city and inhabitants are hand-crafted surreal illustrations. Mood: the uncanny, whimsical paper-collage witch-labyrinth atmosphere associated with Puella Magi Madoka Magica, but an original world. Layered antique paper, etched architectural fragments, stitched felt, lace, theatrical flattened perspective, strange scale. Cute tiny original creatures with the diminutive, simple, vulnerable charm of Chiikawa: bean-shaped ivory, pale peach and dusty blue bodies, two dot eyes, tiny stubby limbs, unique little folded-paper leaf hats. Not exact existing characters. Each resident is smaller than the giant person's fingernail and buildings only palm height; make this scale difference unmistakable. Cohesive palette of muted cream and dusty pink with deep midnight blue and small vermilion accents. Visual contrast: almost too cute residents inside a slightly unsettling beautiful storybook city. Gentle absurd cartoon play. No gore, no realistic harm. No VR, headsets, controllers, sensors, phones or extra participants. Make the composition rich but readable and art-directed, not generic glossy 3D fantasy. Scene: establishing hero shot. A photoreal adult East Asian woman in a plain charcoal long sleeve top, black shoulder-length bob, appears from the waist up as a huge curious visitor beyond a dense miniature city. Her face high near the center, one open palm rests near a tiny plaza with dozens of leaf-hat inhabitants gazing up. Foreground intricately collaged crooked apartment facades, miniature crosswalk, striped shop awnings, thread-like tram cables, a little clock tower, theatrical paper moon and circular lace clouds. A few residents peek out from windows; one stands on the edge of her palm. Wide cinematic view with strong foreground depth; city takes lower half, photographic face and hands clear against indigo sky. Emotion: wonder and a little strangeness. No action trails or interface.
